audience: Puzzle players who like Portal-style planning plus speedrun-style repetition; 5 to 15 minute sessions.
core_mechanic: Record a timed run, then replay it as a ghost that holds pressure plates and opens gates while the live player moves through the same vault.
monetization: Free, no ads, no account, cosmetic optional later.
title: Echo Heist: solo time-loop co-op
why_hot: A co-op puzzle where the partner is your own recorded past run. It is the freshest mechanic on this week's new-browser-games list and needs no netcode, so a single-file build can carry it.

core_mechanic: Not a game. A market signal: legible-in-one-sentence pitch, then depth that produces replayable stories.
title: Indie new IP breakouts: instant readability plus systemic depth
why_hot: The market data behind the originality directive: new IP and small teams took a much larger share of 2026 breakouts, and the common thread is instant readability followed by enough systemic depth to generate a second story.

core_mechanic: Free-paint camouflage on your own body to match the surface behind you while hunters search.
title: MECCHA CHAMELEON: paint yourself to hide
why_hot: The clearest 2026 example of a one-sentence mechanic that is also a clip factory. Camouflage-as-input is a mechanic nobody had shipped at scale before this year.
